title: dactylorhiza elata var. brennensis
intro: Dactylorhiza elata var. brennensis, commonly known as the Alpine Marsh Orchid, is a type of orchid that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its antioxidant and vasodilatory effects. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza elata var. brennensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiotonic properties, which are mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The specific bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects have been identified as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its potential use in traditional medicine for various health conditions.
